# Stage Four Cert — Project Guide

## Overview
A minimal Node.js/Express API demonstrating JWT authentication and user management. Built with TypeScript.
**Stack**: Express, TypeScript, dotenv, jsonwebtoken

## Common Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm start` | Start the server (ts-node) |
| `npm test` | No test runner configured yet |

## Architecture

### API Routes
| Route | Auth | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `GET /api/users` | Required | List all users |
| `GET /api/users/:id` | Required | Get a single user |

### Authentication
JWT-based. All routes require a Bearer token except those in PUBLIC_PATHS in src/auth.ts.

### Directory Structure
```
src/
  index.ts          — Express app entry point
  auth.ts           — JWT middleware
  app/api/
    users/
      route.ts      — GET /api/users, GET /api/users/:id
```

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Yes | PostgreSQL connection string |
| `JWT_SECRET` | Yes | Secret for signing/verifying JWTs |
| `API_KEY` | Yes | External API key |
| `PORT` | No | Server port (default: 3000) |

output:
# Stage Four Cert — Project Guide

## Overview
A minimal Node.js/Express API demonstrating JWT authentication and user management. Built with TypeScript.
**Stack**: Express, TypeScript, dotenv, jsonwebtoken

## Quick Start
```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env
# Fill in .env with your credentials
npm start
```

## Common Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm start` | Start the server (ts-node) |
| `npm test` | No test runner configured yet |

## Architecture

### API Routes
| Route | Auth | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `GET /api/health` | — | Health check (status, timestamp) |
| `GET /api/users` | ✓ Required | List all users |
| `GET /api/users/:id` | ✓ Required | Get a single user |

### Authentication
**JWT-based Bearer tokens**. Routes in `PUBLIC_PATHS` (src/auth.ts) bypass authentication. All other routes require a valid JWT in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

### Directory Structure
```
src/
  index.ts                    — Express app entry point
  auth.ts                     — JWT middleware & PUBLIC_PATHS config
  cache.ts                    — In-memory caching (node-cache)
  app/api/
    health/
      route.ts                — GET /api/health
    users/
      route.ts                — GET /api/users, GET /api/users/:id
```

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Yes | PostgreSQL connection string |
| `JWT_SECRET` | Yes | Secret for signing/verifying JWTs |
| `API_KEY` | Yes | External API key |
| `PORT` | No | Server port (default: 3000) |
| `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL` | No | Cache interval for health checks (ms) |

## Key Modules
- **express** — Web framework
- **jsonwebtoken** — JWT signing/verification
- **dotenv** — Environment configuration
- **node-cache** — In-memory caching
- **typescript** — Type safety

## Development
- **ts-node** compiles and runs TypeScript directly
- **@types/** packages provide type definitions
- No test runner configured yet
